name: CSRE1/CSRE2 resonance-analysis and verification vertical slice

alpha_B_numerical.method: Existing DigitalTwin explicit Euler time-domain integration with zero-crossing frequency estimate

beta_verification.method: Independent comparison of numerical estimate to analytical reference
beta_verification.note: The 0.05 Hz tolerance is a value found in the historical source fragment, not a newly approved architecture-performance threshold.

determinism.clock_and_ids: Historical code uses wall-clock-derived IDs; benchmark harness must inject fixed IDs/clock or deterministic ID generator.
determinism.randomness: SensorHardwareGateway uses Gaussian noise with no source-recorded seed. Exclude this stage from deterministic core workload unless a fixed seed and RNG implementation are declared.
determinism.source_integrity: Do not edit the historical source artifact. Any harness composition must be a separate DERIVED_RECONSTRUCTION with attribution edges.

workflow.beta: Independently recompute/check both results and report discrepancy.
workflow.gamma: No production authority or consequential target operation is present in the recovered workload; authority/fencing gates require separate existing tests and actual target source.
workflow.sigma: Produce a provenance-linked comparison view without promoting simulation agreement to physical validation.

known_integration_gap: The historical main orchestration hardcodes simulated_measurement=1.59155 and does not call the separate DigitalTwin implementation. Connecting Alpha B to C4PO is a new derived benchmark harness, not an existing recovered call-site.
epistemic_limit: Numerical agreement demonstrates only internal analytical/simulation consistency under the stated model. It does not establish experimental or physical validation.
freeze_requirements: Harness and exact source attribution reviewed
Fixed IDs/clock and any RNG seed specified
Execution environment and resource envelope fixed
Common architecture test schedule and repetition count pre-registered
